scope: Static read-only clarification. No runtime/build/test/simulation/browser/HTTP/repair/retry or repository edits. This is a fresh append-only owned temporary addendum; the previously sent report remains unchanged.
answer: The authored stealth content supplies a usable ordinary illusion caster. fairies-1 already gives the player a separate Veilweaver and lists it as an infiltrator; its pinned Queen Step commander is a different entity. The fresh route did not cast. This is a missing observed authored cast, not an authored-content inability to use illusions.

allSixAuthoredStartingArmies.briefing: Rakka chooses a hidden crossing. Move through the western ravine, take the courier orders at the northern archive, and return to Torg. Two alarms close the route.

Liora searches the watcher archive for the missing grove wards. Patrols face along their routes. Walk behind them, collect the ward record, and return to the southern glade; Veil Doubles can draw a watcher away.
Bryn scouts the northern works alone while Sena holds Deep Gate. Take the pump plans at the east archive and return through the high western passage. Two detections bring down the tunnel shutters.
Mara enters the patrol camp with Iven waiting outside. Recover the erased burial list from the eastern watchbook and return without two alarms. Move rather than attack through the high northern path.
Neris crosses the wet western flats to the harbor archive. Recover the ledger and return to Pell without two alarms. Machine patrols use the dry piers; Tideborn can take the mud around them.
K-7 enters the survey depot to recover the order that cut power to the foundry. Follow the western road, reach the northern archive, and return to Assembler M-2 without two alarms.

availabilityExplanation: The actual fairies-1 starting entity2 is a living implicit Fairy special unit with hp105, no ability cooldown and ordinary player movement recorded. unitFor resolves it to fairy-special Veilweaver/illusion. Raw disabled-definition and draft-ban lists are empty, draft is disabled, and both ordinary clone candidate positions are grass. Fixed army and zero recruitment do not prohibit ordinary ability commands. This conclusion is source applicability plus actual supplied actor/state, not a newly executed cast.
otherFiveContentLimit: The other five authored stealth starting detachments supply a pinned faction commander and a worker, with no ordinary illusion caster. Their commander abilities are Iron Command, Thane Ward, Soul Drain, Admiral Wave and Prime Shield. They do not individually provide Veil Doubles, and no claim that every faction stealth mission must do so is added.
campaignReserves: No reserve is needed: fairies-1 is the first Fairy campaign chapter and is also a Practice mission. Carryover only replaces existing slots matching role, definitionId and commander/noncommander label status. It does not append surplus units or replace another faction pinned commander with an ordinary Veilweaver. The other five restricted detachments therefore do not gain an extra illusion slot through carried reserves.

customDefinitionNativeAccess.confirmedPath: A native captureScenario checkpoint of the valid custom Veilweaver definition is admissible through the existing visible Load mission / Import mission checkpoint API. The cast test already admits the custom definition through createScenario; captureScenario produces the generic envelope; restoreScenario validates that embedded definition and game rather than checking an authored-ID allowlist. ScenarioTools calls that same native restore and the mounted host launches the result.

customDefinitionNativeAccess.testEvidence: The retained passed custom cast case proves real native admission/use of the custom definition. The retained implicit built-in admission case proves no content bundle is required. The retained small-resource-free authored-map save/replay case proves native checkpoint restoration does not impose editor-map nearby-resource rules.
customDefinitionNativeAccess.limit: The exact custom cast checkpoint was not newly imported through the browser. This is API/schema reachability proved by source and retained cases, not a fresh browser observation.
customDefinitionNativeAccess.editorRoute: A separate visible ScenarioPackage editor import/play route exists and has a retained passing import/play control test. It requires its normal valid map/package wrapper. The raw custom test definition alone is not asserted to be an editor package. The native checkpoint path does not invoke that wrapper or the failed editor-map generator.
customDefinitionNativeAccess.noAdditionalGate: Packaging or whole-role browser completion is not required as a new acceptance condition; authored fairies-1 already provides playable illusion-capable stealth content.
customDefinitionNativeAccess.controlVisibility: Load mission controls are visible after a mission exists (ScenarioTools.ts:98). Launching any available practice mission exposes that file control, after which the admitted custom native checkpoint replaces it through the same start callback.

conclusion: No authored-content access limitation is found for original78 as a feature. The clear current observation limit is zero recorded illusion casts in fresh authored stealth runs. Existing authored Fairy caster access and the unchanged retained real infiltration/illusion/restricted-army case jointly support the original clause without inventing a new gate.
